title: Feeling Anticipation & Seeking Good in Decisions
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا الْأَمْرُ خَيْرًا لِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ
transliteration: Allāhumma in kāna hādhā al-amru khayran lī faqdur-hu lī wa yassir-hu lī thumma bārik lī fīhi
translation: Oh Allah, if my intended action is best for me, make it destined and easy for me, and grant me Your blessings in it.
reference: Part of the Istikhara Du'a – Sahih Bukhari 1166
